entries.descriptionHtml: Ithu'rath unleashes a cloud of transformative slime. Each creature within 60 feet of Ithu'rath who isn't an olothec or a slime servant must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 45 (10d8) piercing damage and is blinded until the end of their next turn as their eyes temporarily turn into insectoid feelers. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.
entries: Ithu'rath unleashes a cloud of transformative slime. Each creature within 60 feet of Ithu'rath who isn't an olothec or a slime servant must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn as their eyes temporarily turn into insectoid feelers. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

lairActions.name: Baleful Teleport
lairActions.descriptionHtml: A surge of psionic power scours up to two creatures Ithu'rath can see within 60 feet of Ithu'rath. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the olothec can see.
entries: A surge of psionic power scours up to two creatures Ithu'rath can see within 60 feet of Ithu'rath. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the olothec can see.

lairActions.name: Psychic Shock
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Ithu'rath targets up to two creatures within 30 feet of them who are under the slime effect of Ithu'rath's Devolving Tentacle. Each target takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and Ithu'rath regains a number of hit points equal to the total damage taken.
entries: Ithu'rath targets up to two creatures within 30 feet of them who are under the slime effect of Ithu'rath's Devolving Tentacle. Each target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage and Ithu'rath regains a number of hit points equal to the total damage taken.

lairActions.name: Slime Eruption
lairActions.descriptionHtml: A surge of toxic slime erupts from tunnels or caverns, targeting up to three creatures within 120 feet of Ithu'rath. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.
entries: A surge of toxic slime erupts from tunnels or caverns, targeting up to three creatures within 120 feet of Ithu'rath. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

lairHeader: When fighting inside their lair, Ithu'rath can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Ithu'rath can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; Ithu'rath can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:
lairActionsDesc: When fighting inside their lair, Ithu'rath can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Ithu'rath can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; Ithu'rath can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:

traits.name: Multiple Tongues
traits.descriptionHtml: The worm has three tongues, each of which can be targeted with attacks (AC 20, immunity to psychic damage) while that tongue is grappling a creature. When a tongue takes 35 damage or more in a single turn, that tongue is destroyed, releasing any target it was grappling. The worm can't use a destroyed tongue with their Multiattack or Tongue Grab action until they finish a long rest. Damaging or destroying a tongue deals no damage to the worm.
entries: The worm has three tongues, each of which can be targeted with attacks (AC 20, immunity to psychic damage) while that tongue is grappling a creature. When a tongue takes 35 damage or more in a single turn, that tongue is destroyed, releasing any target it was grappling. The worm can't use a destroyed tongue with their Multiattack or Tongue Grab action until they finish a long rest. Damaging or destroying a tongue deals no damage to the worm.

traits.name: Slowed, Not Stopped (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: When the worm fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, their speed and the reach of their Tongue Grab attack are each reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until they finish a long rest. The worm's speed and reach can't be reduced below 5 feet in this way.
entries: When the worm fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, their speed and the reach of their Tongue Grab attack are each reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until they finish a long rest. The worm's speed and reach can't be reduced below 5 feet in this way.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.descriptionHtml: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The worm can make a number of Tongue Grab attacks equal to the number of tongues they currently have (see Multiple Tongues). The worm can replace any number of those attacks with a use of Swallow.
entries: The worm can make a number of Tongue Grab attacks equal to the number of tongues they currently have (see Multiple Tongues). The worm can replace any number of those attacks with a use of Swallow.

actions.name: Tongue Grab
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) acid damage, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the worm can't use this tongue against another target.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage, and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). Until this grapple ends, the worm can't use this tongue against another target.

actions.name: Maw
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, they must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, they must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.descriptionHtml:
The worm pulls a Huge or smaller grappled creature into their maw and swallows them. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled, but they are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and take 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside them, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution check at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of whom fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.
entries: The worm pulls a Huge or smaller {@condition grappled} creature into their maw and swallows them. A swallowed creature is no longer {@condition grappled}, but they are {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside them, the worm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution check at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of whom fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

bonusActions.name: Tongue Sweep
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The worm violently swings a creature they have grappled. The grappled creature takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage, and each enemy within 10 feet of the grappled creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.
entries: The worm violently swings a creature they have {@condition grappled}. The {@condition grappled} creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage, and each enemy within 10 feet of the {@condition grappled} creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Tongue Recall
reactions.descriptionHtml: When one of the worm's tongues takes damage that doesn't immediately destroy it, the worm can release any target that tongue is grappling and recall the tongue back inside the worm's body. That tongue can't be targeted until the worm uses it to grapple a creature again.
entries: When one of the worm's tongues takes damage that doesn't immediately destroy it, the worm can release any target that tongue is grappling and recall the tongue back inside the worm's body. That tongue can't be targeted until the worm uses it to grapple a creature again.

legendaryActions.description: The worm has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: Open the Earth
entries.descriptionHtml: The worm writhes, sending tremors through the ground and opening a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-long, 40-foot-deep fissure in the ground, originating from the worm. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the fissure, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing prone. On a successful save, a creature flees to the closest unoccupied space outside the fissure's area.
entries: The worm writhes, sending tremors through the ground and opening a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-long, 40-foot-deep fissure in the ground, originating from the worm. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the fissure, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature flees to the closest unoccupied space outside the fissure's area.

entries.name: Action 2: Earth Breach
entries.descriptionHtml: The worm burrows up to half their speed and then bursts through the surface, breaching the ground in a 10-foot-radius circle. Huge and smaller creatures within that area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).
entries: The worm burrows up to half their speed and then bursts through the surface, breaching the ground in a 10-foot-radius circle. Huge and smaller creatures within that area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).

entries.name: Action 3: Better Out Than In
entries.descriptionHtml: The worm projectile vomits the contents of their stomach in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, creatures who were swallowed by the worm are regurgitated, taking 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and landing prone in an unoccupied space of the worm's choice within that area.
entries: The worm projectile vomits the contents of their stomach in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, creatures who were swallowed by the worm are regurgitated, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space of the worm's choice within that area.

traits.name: Corrupting Phasing
traits.descriptionHtml: Kiona can move through other creatures and objects. Kiona takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object. A creature takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage the first time Kiona passes through them on a turn.
entries: Kiona can move through other creatures and objects. Kiona takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object. A creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage the first time Kiona passes through them on a turn.

traits.name: Incorporeal Empowerment
traits.descriptionHtml: Each incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of Kiona ignores difficult terrain.
entries: Each incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of Kiona ignores difficult terrain.

traits.name: Spiritual Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: When Kiona fails a saving throw, she can lose 15 hit points and choose to succeed instead.
entries: When Kiona fails a saving throw, she can lose 15 hit points and choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Kiona makes two Energy Siphon attacks.
entries: Kiona makes two Energy Siphon attacks.

actions.name: Energy Siphon
actions.descriptionHtml: Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Kiona's next turn. Kiona gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt by this attack.
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Kiona's next turn. Kiona gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt by this attack.

actions.name: Rise from Death (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: Kiona conjures three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under her control. Each summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kiona and acts immediately after her turn on the same initiative count.
entries: Kiona conjures three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under her control. Each summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kiona and acts immediately after her turn on the same initiative count.

bonusActions.name: Path of Pain
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Kiona chooses one other incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of her who can see her. That Undead can move up to their speed.
entries: Kiona chooses one other incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of her who can see her. That Undead can move up to their speed.

reactions.name: Death's Breath
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature within 5 feet of Kiona hits her with an attack, she breathes a toxin at the creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Kiona hits her with an attack, she breathes a toxin at the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

legendaryActions.description: Kiona has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: Restrain Them!
entries.descriptionHtml: A 20-foot-radius sphere of spectral arms emerges from a point Kiona can see within 120 feet of her. Each enemy in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of Kiona's next turn.
entries: A 20-foot-radius sphere of spectral arms emerges from a point Kiona can see within 120 feet of her. Each enemy in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of Kiona's next turn.

entries.name: Action 2: Ruinous March
entries.descriptionHtml: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
entries: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Action 3: Vitality Drain
entries.descriptionHtml: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can make a melee attack (no action required). A creature hit by one of these attacks gains a level of exhaustion.
entries: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can make a melee attack (no action required). A creature hit by one of these attacks gains a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Gladius)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 plus PB piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the decanus can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the decanus can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Reinforce (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: When the decanus sees an ally within 30 feet of them being targeted by an attack, the decanus can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the target. If the decanus ends their movement within 5 feet of the target, the target gains a +PB bonus to their AC until the beginning of the decanus's next turn, including against the triggering attack.
entries: When the decanus sees an ally within 30 feet of them being targeted by an attack, the decanus can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the target. If the decanus ends their movement within 5 feet of the target, the target gains a +PB bonus to their AC until the beginning of the decanus's next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: 5th Level: Shield Bash (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The decanus attempts to topple a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Succeed or fail, the decanus then makes two signature attacks against any creature within reach.
entries: The decanus attempts to topple a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. Succeed or fail, the decanus then makes two signature attacks against any creature within reach.

actions.name: 7th Level: One-Kobold Army (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The decanus moves up to their speed, then makes a number of signature attacks equal to the number of enemies within 5 feet of them (minimum of three attacks). Each enemy within range must be attacked at least once. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Charisma saving throw or be frightened of the decanus for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
entries: The decanus moves up to their speed, then makes a number of signature attacks equal to the number of enemies within 5 feet of them (minimum of three attacks). Each enemy within range must be attacked at least once. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the decanus for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Koptourok
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Breathless Aura
traits.descriptionHtml: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.
entries: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Wings of Breath
traits.descriptionHtml: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.
entries: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.
entries: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Choking Grasp
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.

actions.name: Last Gasp
actions.descriptionHtml: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.
entries: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.

reactions.name: Thunderous Deflation
reactions.descriptionHtml: When the koptourok drops to 30 hit points or fewer, they unleash a shrieking wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the koptourok must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 (3d10) thunder damage and is deafened until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened. The koptourok then releases all creatures they are grappling and flies up to their speed.
entries: When the koptourok drops to 30 hit points or fewer, they unleash a shrieking wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the koptourok must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) thunder damage and is {@condition deafened} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition deafened}. The koptourok then releases all creatures they are grappling and flies up to their speed.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.descriptionHtml: If the lacuna is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.
entries: If the lacuna is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.descriptionHtml: While the lacuna remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal statue.
entries: While the lacuna remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal statue.

traits.name: Fiend Between
traits.descriptionHtml: The lacuna doesn't have a walking speed and can't benefit from any bonus to their speed.
entries: The lacuna doesn't have a walking speed and can't benefit from any bonus to their speed.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The lacuna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
entries: The lacuna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The lacuna makes three Grief-Eater attacks and uses Infuse Sadness, if available.
entries: The lacuna makes three Grief-Eater attacks and uses Infuse Sadness, if available.

actions.name: Grief-Eater
actions.descriptionHtml: Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) psychic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) psychic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Infuse Sadness (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: Each enemy the lacuna can see within 30 feet of them must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed with grief for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While a creature is overwhelmed, attacks against them are made with advantage.
entries: Each enemy the lacuna can see within 30 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed with grief for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While a creature is overwhelmed, attacks against them are made with advantage.

bonusActions.name: Slip Between
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.
entries: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

reactions.name: Slip Away
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature within 60 feet of the lacuna targets them with an attack, the lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If the lacuna is no longer a valid target for the triggering attack, the attacker must choose a new target or the attack misses.
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the lacuna targets them with an attack, the lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If the lacuna is no longer a valid target for the triggering attack, the attacker must choose a new target or the attack misses.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Lady Emer

traits.name: Stone Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.
entries: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.
entries: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of Emer's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can't take reactions.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of Emer's next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target can't take reactions.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

actions.name: Pinning Shot
actions.descriptionHtml: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is restrained by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature restrained in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.
entries: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is {@condition restrained} by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.

actions.name: Stone Gaze
actions.descriptionHtml:
Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are dazed until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and dazed in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are petrified and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer's Stone Sacrifice trait, a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a greater restoration spell, or a similar supernatural effect.
entries: Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are {@condition petrified} and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer's Stone Sacrifice trait, a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Envenomed Stone (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Mesmerizing Eyes
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The glowing eyes of Emer's snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the target's next turn. A target charmed in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer's choice.
entries: The glowing eyes of Emer's snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the start of the target's next turn. A target {@condition charmed} in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer's choice.

reactions.name: Blinding Mucus
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature Emer can see within 5 feet of her hits her with a melee attack, Emer spits venom at their eyes. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) acid damage and be blinded until the start of their next turn.
entries: When a creature Emer can see within 5 feet of her hits her with a melee attack, Emer spits venom at their eyes. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.

legendaryActions.description: Emer has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: I See You!
entries.descriptionHtml: Emer uses Stone Gaze against each enemy she can see within 60 feet of her.
entries: Emer uses Stone Gaze against each enemy she can see within 60 feet of her.

entries.name: Action 2: Medusa's Evolution
entries.descriptionHtml: Emer grows wings from her back, gaining a flying speed of 40 feet, then she moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. After 1 minute, the wings crumble to dust and her flying speed is lost.
entries: Emer grows wings from her back, gaining a flying speed of 40 feet, then she moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. After 1 minute, the wings crumble to dust and her flying speed is lost.

entries.name: Action 3: Stone Puppets
entries.descriptionHtml: Emer mentally manipulates the stone in each creature who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze. Emer and each of those creatures move up to their speed then make a weapon attack against a creature of Emer's choice (no action required).
entries: Emer mentally manipulates the stone in each creature who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze. Emer and each of those creatures move up to their speed then make a weapon attack against a creature of Emer's choice (no action required).

lairActions.name: Shadowstep
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Emer teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.
entries: Emer teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

lairActions.name: Stony Wail
lairActions.descriptionHtml: The statues in Emer's lair scream in pain. Each enemy within 60 feet of Emer who can hear the statues must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Emer until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.
entries: The statues in Emer's lair scream in pain. Each enemy within 60 feet of Emer who can hear the statues must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Emer until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.

lairActions.name: Venom Shower
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Black venom rains down in a 10-footradius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point Emer can see within 90 feet of her. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.
entries: Black venom rains down in a 10-footradius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point Emer can see within 90 feet of her. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.

lairHeader: When fighting inside her lair, Lady Emer can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), she can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; she can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.descriptionHtml: If the lightbender is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.
entries: If the lightbender is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.descriptionHtml: If the lightbender moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits them with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lightbender can make one Bite attack against them as a bonus action.
entries: If the lightbender moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits them with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the lightbender can make one Bite attack against them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The lightbender makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or uses their Tail Whip twice.
entries: The lightbender makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or uses their Tail Whip twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Whip
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

actions.name: Hypnotic Mane (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lightbender discharges the light absorbed in their mane into a brilliant, mesmerizing display. Each creature within 15 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the lightbender for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, a creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. If a creature charmed in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends for that creature.
entries: The lightbender discharges the light absorbed in their mane into a brilliant, mesmerizing display. Each creature within 15 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the lightbender for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0. If a creature {@condition charmed} in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends for that creature.

reactions.name: Afterimage
reactions.descriptionHtml: When the lightbender is hit by an attack, they can reveal that the attacker is attacking a past visual imprint of the lightbender. The lightbender appears in an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of their imprint, the attack misses, then the imprint disappears. The lightbender can't use this reaction if the attacker relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if they can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

actions.name: 1st Level: Tail Whip (2 Ferocity)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lightbender makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 0d1 + PB radiant damage to the target, and a different creature the lightbender chooses within 15 feet of them takes PB radiant damage.
entries: The lightbender makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} radiant damage to the target, and a different creature the lightbender chooses within 15 feet of them takes PB radiant damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lightbender teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. Before or after teleporting, the lightbender can make a signature attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone.
entries: The lightbender teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. Before or after teleporting, the lightbender can make a signature attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

actions.name: 5th Level: Hypnotic Mane (8 Ferocity)
actions.descriptionHtml: Each creature within 10 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the lightbender until the end of the lightbender's next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. If a creature charmed in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends on that creature.

reactions.name: Shared Afterimage (Recharges after a Long Rest)
reactions.descriptionHtml: When the lightbender and their caregiver are within 30 feet of each other and one of them is hit by an attack, the lightbender reveals that both they and their caregiver are past visual imprints. The lightbender and the caregiver each appear in an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of their imprints, the attack misses, then the imprints disappear. The lightbender can't use this reaction if the attacker relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if they can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

actions.name: Necrotic Drain
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage, or 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage if the target can't see the lightthief.
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage, or 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) necrotic damage if the target can't see the lightthief.

actions.name: Into the Light {@recharge}
actions.descriptionHtml: The lightthief teleports inside a light source they can see within 15 feet of them that is emitting bright or dim light. While inside the light source, the lightthief has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the light source. If the light source is extinguished by any means other than the lightthief's Steal Light action, the lightthief is forced out, appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source, and is paralyzed until the end of their next turn.
entries: The lightthief teleports inside a light source they can see within 15 feet of them that is emitting bright or dim light. While inside the light source, the lightthief has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the light source. If the light source is extinguished by any means other than the lightthief's Steal Light action, the lightthief is forced out, appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source, and is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Steal Light (Inside Light Source Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lightthief can cause the light they are inside to erupt in a burst of brilliant radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the light source must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) radiant damage and loses any darkvision they have for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't lose their darkvision. After this, the light source extinguishes and the lightthief appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source.
entries: The lightthief can cause the light they are inside to erupt in a burst of brilliant radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the light source must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage and loses any darkvision they have for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't lose their darkvision. After this, the light source extinguishes and the lightthief appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.descriptionHtml: The bloodeye can breathe air and water.
entries: The bloodeye can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Servant Senses
traits.descriptionHtml: Ithu'rath can sense anything the bloodeye senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the bloodeye senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The bloodeye makes one Bite or one Bola attack and uses Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure, if available.
entries: The bloodeye makes one Bite or one Bola attack and uses Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bola
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is restrained by the bola. A creature can use their action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach from the bola on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the bola (AC 10) destroys it and frees a creature restrained by it without harming them.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition restrained} by the bola. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the bola (AC 10) destroys it and frees a creature {@condition restrained} by it without harming them.

actions.name: Bloodeye Bolt (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The bloodeye shoots blood from their eyes at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
entries: The bloodeye shoots blood from their eyes at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Mesmeric Lure (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The bloodeye hypnotically stares at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or all creatures other than the bloodeye are invisible to them until the end of the bloodeye's next turn.
entries: The bloodeye hypnotically stares at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or all creatures other than the bloodeye are {@condition invisible} to them until the end of the bloodeye's next turn.

reactions.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
reactions.descriptionHtml: If the bloodeye fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.
entries: If the bloodeye fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Greatsword)
actions.descriptionHtml: Attack: +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 plus PB slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the hunter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the hunter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Wrenching Bite (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). Until the grapple ends, the target takes PB piercing damage at the end of each of their turns, and the hunter can't use their Wrenching Bite against another target.
entries: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until the grapple ends, the target takes PB piercing damage at the end of each of their turns, and the hunter can't use their Wrenching Bite against another target.

actions.name: 5th Level: Thrashing Tail (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. While the hunter is within 5 feet of this prone target, the target can't stand up unless they use an action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the target can stand up.
entries: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. While the hunter is within 5 feet of this {@condition prone} target, the target can't stand up unless they use an action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the target can stand up.

actions.name: 7th Level: Hypnotic Sleep (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: As a bonus action, the hunter drones lullingly. Each creature within 5 feet of the hunter who can hear them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. An unconscious target wakes up if they take damage, the hunter becomes incapacitated, the hunter moves more than 5 feet away from the target, or another creature uses an action to rouse the target.
entries: As a bonus action, the hunter drones lullingly. Each creature within 5 feet of the hunter who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. An {@condition unconscious} target wakes up if they take damage, the hunter becomes {@condition incapacitated}, the hunter moves more than 5 feet away from the target, or another creature uses an action to rouse the target.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Lord Syuul

traits.name: Draw In
traits.descriptionHtml: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all grappled creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.
entries: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all {@condition grappled} creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.
entries: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 19).
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

actions.name: Psionic Repeater
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) force damage.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) force damage.

actions.name: Brain Overload (1/Day; 6th-Order Power)
actions.descriptionHtml: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (14d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.
entries: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 77 ({@damage 14d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.

actions.name: Flay (6th-Order Power)
actions.descriptionHtml: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Memory Transfer
actions.descriptionHtml:
Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

  • The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the cure ailment power, a lesser restoration spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.
  • The target is charmed by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is charmed, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
entries: Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

items: The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.

The target is {@condition charmed} by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is {@condition charmed}, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
actions.descriptionHtml:
Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a DC 19 Intelligence (Investigation) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.
entries: Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a {@dc 19} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonusActions.name: Grappling Jaunt
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Lord Syuul and each creature grappled by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.
entries: Lord Syuul and each creature {@condition grappled} by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

reactions.name: Brain Drain
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature grappled by Lord Syuul makes a saving throw against Memory Transfer, Lord Syuul momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by Lord Syuul makes a saving throw against Memory Transfer, Lord Syuul momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendaryActions.description: Lord Syuul has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: Mindblind
entries.descriptionHtml: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't see creatures other than Lord Syuul for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't see creatures other than Lord Syuul for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

entries.name: Action 2: Was I Ever Here?
entries.descriptionHtml: Lord Syuul becomes invisible, teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and can take the Hide action. At the same time, an illusory psionic image of Lord Syuul appears in the space he left, gesturing, speaking, and behaving as he chooses (no action required). A creature who touches the image for the first time on a turn or makes a melee attack against it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage because things can pass through it. Lord Syuul's invisibility ends and his image disappears at the end of his next turn.
entries: Lord Syuul becomes {@condition invisible}, teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and can take the Hide action. At the same time, an illusory psionic image of Lord Syuul appears in the space he left, gesturing, speaking, and behaving as he chooses (no action required). A creature who touches the image for the first time on a turn or makes a melee attack against it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage because things can pass through it. Lord Syuul's invisibility ends and his image disappears at the end of his next turn.

entries.name: Action 3: Mindshatter
entries.descriptionHtml: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

lairActions.name: Excremus March
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Both excremus mouths can each move up to 30 feet along the wall in directions of Syuul's choice.
entries: Both excremus mouths can each move up to 30 feet along the wall in directions of Syuul's choice.

lairActions.name: Screaming Protection
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Psionic projections of fleshy mouths cover Lord Syuul and scream at his aggressors. When a creature within 5 feet of Lord Syuul hits him with a melee attack, the attacker must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) thunder damage. The mouths disappear at the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.
entries: Psionic projections of fleshy mouths cover Lord Syuul and scream at his aggressors. When a creature within 5 feet of Lord Syuul hits him with a melee attack, the attacker must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) thunder damage. The mouths disappear at the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.

actions.name: Envelop
actions.descriptionHtml:
While grappling a creature, the mimic uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into an object that is the same size or bigger than the grappled creature (if the mimic isn't already in such a form). The creature is then enveloped by the mimic. An enveloped creature is no longer grappled, but they can't breathe, are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mimic, and take 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic's turns. When the mimic moves, the enveloped creature moves with them. The mimic can envelop one creature at a time.

An enveloped creature can use their action to try to escape by making a DC 13 Strength check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer enveloped and is shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mimic. The creature automatically escapes if the mimic uses Shapechanger or Panic Shift, becomes incapacitated, or dies.

reactions.name: Panic Shift (1/Day)
reactions.descriptionHtml: When the mimic takes damage, they release any grappled or enveloped creatures and then polymorph into a Small dense object with spikes, such as an iron ball or helm. While in this form, the mimic's walking and climbing speeds are doubled, they have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, they can only take the Dash, Disengage, or Shapechanger action, and a creature who touches the mimic or hits them with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage. This effect ends when the mimic dies or uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into another form.

actions.name: Mindwipe
actions.descriptionHtml:
A Humanoid grappled by the mindkiller must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or the mindkiller enters the Humanoid's body. While inside a Humanoid, the mindkiller has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the Humanoid, and the only action the mindkiller can take is to leave the body, exiting in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body.

When a Humanoid ends their turn with the mindkiller inside of them, they must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 necrotic damage. If the Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points, they die and the mindkiller takes over the body, which regains hit points equal to the Humanoid's hit point maximum. The mindkiller retains their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, their understanding of Deep Speech and Undercommon, and their telepathy. They otherwise adopt the target's statistics and can take the actions the creature could take. They know everything the creature knew, including spells, class features, traits, and languages. If the body is reduced to 0 hit points after the mindkiller takes control, the mindkiller must leave it.

A creature wielding a sharp tool or weapon within reach of a Humanoid host or body with a mindkiller inside can use an action to attempt to remove the mindkiller, making an attack roll against the Humanoid's AC if the host is unwilling. On a hit, the creature deals 11 (2d10) slashing damage to the host and must make a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. On a successful check, the creature cuts the mindkiller out of the host. On a faiIed check, if this slashing damage reduced the host to 0 hit points, the mindkiller kills the host; otherwise, there is no effect.

3e.components: V, S, M (incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each)

3e.name: Scrying
3e.components: V, S, M (a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror, or water-filled font)

traits.name: Turbulent Escalation
traits.descriptionHtml:
When the oracle starts their turn outdoors while not incapacitated, they can stoke a thunderstorm (no action required). For 1 minute or until the oracle uses Turbulent Escalation again, the weather in a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle changes as follows:

  • If the sky is cloudless, it becomes cloudy.
  • If the sky is cloudy, it begins to rain or snow (oracle's choice).
  • If it's raining or snowing, the weather becomes stormy.
entries: When the oracle starts their turn outdoors while not {@condition incapacitated}, they can stoke a thunderstorm (no action required). For 1 minute or until the oracle uses Turbulent Escalation again, the weather in a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle changes as follows:

items: If the sky is cloudless, it becomes cloudy.
If the sky is cloudy, it begins to rain or snow (oracle's choice).
If it's raining or snowing, the weather becomes stormy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The oracle uses Tempest Bolt twice. They can replace one use with a Cyclone Staff attack.
entries: The oracle uses Tempest Bolt twice. They can replace one use with a Cyclone Staff attack.

actions.name: Cyclone Staff
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (4d10) thunder damage, and the oracle moves the target up to 10 feet in any direction.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage, and the oracle moves the target up to 10 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Tempest Bolt
actions.descriptionHtml: A bolt of lightning streaks from the oracle to strike one creature they can see within 90 feet of them, or within 300 feet of them if the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy, they have disadvantage on the saving throw.
entries: A bolt of lightning streaks from the oracle to strike one creature they can see within 90 feet of them, or within 300 feet of them if the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 7d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy, they have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Storms (2/Day)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml:
The oracle imbues the power of storm in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

  • Lightning Within. The Elemental becomes charged with lightning. The next time the Elemental hits a target with an attack within the next minute, the attack deals an extra 33 (6d10) lightning damage.
  • Thunder Burst. A concussive shock wave erupts from the Elemental toward four creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) thunder damage, be pushed up to 10 feet away from the Elemental, and be deafened until the end of the target's next turn.
entries: The oracle imbues the power of storm in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Lightning Within.} The Elemental becomes charged with lightning. The next time the Elemental hits a target with an attack within the next minute, the attack deals an extra 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage.

{@b Thunder Burst.} A concussive shock wave erupts from the Elemental toward four creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage, be pushed up to 10 feet away from the Elemental, and be {@condition deafened} until the end of the target's next turn.

An enemy who starts their turn flying within 30 feet of the pool must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled down by living acid, landing in the nearest unoccupied space of their choice within the pool, take 24 (7d6) acid damage, and be restrained until the start of their next turn.

entries: If the shade takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the shade takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Terrifying
traits.descriptionHtml: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more shades, the enemy must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the shades until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of shades within 5 feet of the enemy. On a successful save, the enemy is immune to the Terrifying trait of all shades for the next 24 hours.
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more shades, the enemy must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the shades until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of shades within 5 feet of the enemy. On a successful save, the enemy is immune to the Terrifying trait of all shades for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Life Drain (Group Attack)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 necrotic damage.
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 necrotic damage.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Shadow
languages: the languages they knew in life

traits.name: Chilling Phasing
traits.descriptionHtml: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The shadow takes 5 (1d10) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 1 cold damage the first time a shadow passes through them on a turn.
entries: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The shadow takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 1 cold damage the first time a shadow passes through them on a turn.

traits.name: Dark Stalker
traits.descriptionHtml: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

actions.name: Chilling Grasp
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) cold damage, and the target's Dexterity score is reduced by 2. The target dies if this reduces its Dexterity to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) cold damage, and the target's Dexterity score is reduced by 2. The target dies if this reduces its Dexterity to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Freezing Dark (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The shadow pours magical darkness out of their hand in a 15-foot cone. A creature with darkvision who isn't an incorporeal Undead can't see through this darkness, and light can't illuminate it. Each creature in this darkness when it first appears must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) cold damage. The darkness remains in that area for 1 minute or until the shadow is destroyed.
entries: The shadow pours magical darkness out of their hand in a 15-foot cone. A creature with darkvision who isn't an incorporeal Undead can't see through this darkness, and light can't illuminate it. Each creature in this darkness when it first appears must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage. The darkness remains in that area for 1 minute or until the shadow is destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Bind
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The shadow targets one creature they can see within 15 feet of them who is in bright or dim light. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be grappled by their own shadow (escape DC 12). The grapple ends if the target is no longer in bright or dim light, or if the shadow who used this bonus action is destroyed.
